Hero_Desc_Meluna:
A melon elemental and her pet, Musk.
She might look ordinary at first, but it is rumored that she is immensely wealthy somehow.
It would be wise to be on her good side.
Album_Like_Meluna: A melon platter she made herself carefully. Listening to other's music.
Album_Wish_Meluna: Being officially recognized as a Noble Elemental.
Album_Meluna1: A melon(?!) elemental. She's proof that any elemental can dwell in Elias. Although she is an elemental with a calm personality, she gets along rather well with Festa, the elf guitarist. She believes that music deeply connected to her soul.
Album_Meluna2: Meluna shares that elementals aren't born as elementals from the outset. During her days as an ordinary melon(...), she inadvertently heard Yggdrasil's humming during the night, and where she found her melon(...) identity.
Album_Meluna3: After becoming an elemental, she no longer can hear the sounds from Yggdrasil. Meluna shyly says, the reason she loves music comes from her wish that someone in the forest might eventually replay the songs she once heard from Yggdrasil.
Album_Meluna4: Meluna, on occasion, mourns for the scores of melons that have been turned into melon bread and ice cream at sprite bakeries at this very moment. When asked if she plans to stop the sprites, she replied, so long as the treats all turn out tasty, then the life of these melons(...) was a good one.
Album_Meluna5: Meluna draws a line between melon elementals and the melon fruit itself. I'm not sure... what she's trying to say. I mean, as Meluna says... so long as they're tasty, that's good enough...?
Album_Meluna6: Meluna hangs out with Festa, sometimes joining her for busking sessions. She sings while Festa plays... But truth be told, they don't sound very good.
Album_Meluna7: Recently, Meluna secretly signed a music contract behind Festa's back. The business model includes pay-per-play charges and a monthly subscription. Apparently the genre is "Melogressive Grunge," but I'm not sure what that means... Since Festa must never find out about this, all the royalties go straight to Meluna.
LoveHero_Meluna:
Sometimes it's nice
to take a walk together
like this.
LoveHeroCancel_Meluna:
Would you mind
staying a bit longer?
I'll pay for your friendship.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Hate1: Meluna says this deep-fried dish is too much for her. It seems she has very sophisticated tastes.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Hate2: Meluna waved it away, saying the dish was much too sweet.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like1:
After finishing her meal, Meluna made a strange proposal, asking me if I had any thoughts of selling my ownership of the restaurant. 
I tried to beat around the bush and refused.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like2: Meluna says she usually follows a vegetarian diet for her health. This dish is very well-suited to that.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like3: Saying it was as if she's eating edible gold, she looked as if she made a new discovery.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like4: She suggested adding melon to the songpyeon to elevate them but gave up on the idea when she realized this was on the menu for a limited time.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like5: She wondered if processing melons this way might not make them easier to sell in large quantities.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like6: Meluna asked if there were any plans to market it as a limited-edition item. She seemed quite disappointed when I said there was no need.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like7: Meluna said that food commemorating something holds great value. She then left a high rating and vanished.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like8: While offering me some, Meluna tried it with melon and found it being surprisingly good. The pairing of melon and dark Almond Pralines exceeded expectations.
Food_ChefNote_Meluna_Like9: Meluna was hoping for a melon flavor and was disappointed to learn it wasn't available. "Then I'll wrap the candy in melon and eat it," she decided.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Meluna: You must have bought yourself a nice melonic lifestyle.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine2_Meluna: A greenhouse with air conditioning and heating
Gacha_Result_Line1_Meluna:
I'm Meluna- The melon elemental-
Sing for me-
Meluna_Spawn: Meluna, spirit of melons. Sing for me.
Meluna_Spawn2: Don't worry, there's plenty of melons.
Meluna_Growth1: I've grown stronger, so has my wealth...
Meluna_Victory1: Would you like a fresh slice of melon?
Meluna_Defeat1: It'd be a different story, if it could be solved with money...
Meluna_Defeat2: It seems there are things money can't buy.
Meluna_Affinity1_1: If you sing to your budding melons and they will grow better!
Meluna_Affinity2: What melons have to do with music? You wouldn't get it.
Meluna_Affinity3: I've officially signed a contract with Festa! 90% of the royalties are mine!
Meluna_Affinity4: You think a Melon Elemental is ridiculous? This is what you want to nitpick about?
Meluna_Affinity5: This is as big as a watermelon?!
Meluna_Affinity6: Gabia dislikes pesticides, so I stick to organic farming.
Meluna_Affinity7: Is it really so strange that a Melon Elemental eats melon?
Meluna_Die: I think I am going to melt into ice cream...
Meluna_Die1: I feel like I'm going to melt and turn into ice cream...
Meluna_Die2: I can do... a bit more...
Meluna_LevelUp: I wonder if my balance got stronger too?
Meluna_HeroSkill: My movement has become more efficient.
Meluna_Touch1_2: Even my legal team will overlook this.
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_Meluna_Skin1: A rookie idol skyrocketing to fame. Though the controversy about her skills erupted during her debut, her haters disappeared after her first live performance, where she gave a "small token of sincerity" to the audience.
Meluna_Growth1_Skin1: Meluna, the idol who never stops growing!
Meluna_Growth2_Skin1: The secret to popularity? Perhaps endless effort and capital?
Meluna_Equipment_Skin1: A tribute for me...? But I've got more money than you, don't I...?
Meluna_HeroSkill_Skin1: Hehe, now no one is going to question my talent.
Meluna_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I'm practically a top-tier idol now.
Meluna_Board_Skin1: My tour schedule is always so packed.
Meluna_Touch1_1_Skin1: You're not an anti, are you?
Meluna_Touch1_2_Skin1: I'll let you off the hook. As fan service.
Meluna_Touch2_1_Skin1: I had a long day today, so thank you.
Meluna_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: This calls for a press conference.
Meluna_AsideGet: Mars... I can't believe I can finally go there!
Meluna_AsideUpgrade: I might be lonely by myself. We'll all go to Mars together!
Meluna_SkillCast: You should become nourishment for the melons.
Meluna_SPSkill1: Please become nourishment for the melons.
Meluna_Ultimate1: This is a premium melon. It is expensive, so it will hurt.
Meluna_Birthday: Happy birthday. My account is frozen, so please accept my feelings instead of money.
Meluna_Gacha2: Meluna, spirit of melons. Sing for me.
Meluna_Gacha3: I suppose that was a good melon life too.
Meluna_Line1: You do not know? Hm? Mel... What was it again?
Meluna_Line2: Have you seen the melon thief?
Meluna_Lobby: I hope the melons grow well.
LoveLetter_Meluna: Sending personal letters is rare for me due to my position. But you're special. You're the company's advisor, my friend, and well... I'm not sure how to say it... you're just you.Things move quickly in Monatium, and sometimes it gets tiring. So, please just remain as the special person you are. Please burn this letter after you read it. I'm worried about what might happen if my handwriting gets out.
LoveCall_Meluna:
Master, this is Meluna. I called because I have urgent news.
Tomorrow afternoon, Melu Corporation will hold its first special executive meeting.
The attendees will be you and me, just the two of us.
Ah, and the location is not the Monatium branch, but our headquarters in the Elemental Forest. Do not get confused, and be sure to find your way there.

Hmm... Why such a sudden meeting?
Hehe, you are perceptive as always, Master. Yes, it is an excuse.
I simply wanted to spend some time alone with you again.
I suddenly missed the days when we met, ate delicious melon meals, laughed, and talked together.

You will join me, right? I refuse your refusal.
I cleared my entire schedule, so you may come immediately today instead of waiting until tomorrow.
You are welcome anytime, Master.
Affinity_Meluna_EP01_001: The correct lifestyle for the wealthy is not to brag about money.
Affinity_Meluna_EP01_002: So... how much do you have?
Affinity_Meluna_EP01_003:
I don't really know. How much money do I make from melons?
I stopped counting my money at some point.
Affinity_Meluna_EP01_004: I don't mind hearing you brag.
Affinity_Meluna_EP01_005: Are you hinting that I should spend money on you? I knew it. You're after my money.
Affinity_Meluna_EP01_006: Wouldn't it be strange to be too quiet about it too?
Affinity_Meluna_EP01_007: It's best to live quietly and spend as much as you want without having to be mindful of others.
Affinity_Meluna_EP02_001: What is an appropriate amount to donate?
Affinity_Meluna_EP02_002: There are no limits. You can give whatever you want.
Affinity_Meluna_EP02_003: I need you to give me a point of reference. I'm out of touch with reality when it comes to money, so...
Affinity_Meluna_EP02_004: Donate? Does the Order collect donations? I've never seen that...
Affinity_Meluna_EP02_005:
Really? As far as I know, the Order is a pretty deep-pocketed organization...
It has nothing to do with you, Master?
Affinity_Meluna_EP02_006: About 1,000? 2,000? Every month. You can pay me directly.
Affinity_Meluna_EP02_007: That's pretty specific. It's important to plan your income and expenses.
Affinity_Meluna_EP03_001:
Other elementals think only about nature.
But there are other important things too.
Affinity_Meluna_EP03_002: An elemental who doesn't care about nature? That seems strange...
Affinity_Meluna_EP03_003:
You're too narrow-minded.
If there was a garbage elemental, do you think they'd care about nature?
Affinity_Meluna_EP03_004: There's nothing to lose by protecting nature.
Affinity_Meluna_EP03_005: There's a limit to everything. If you're too obsessed with one thing, it can cause problems.
Affinity_Meluna_EP03_006: You aren't trying to say that money is important, are you?
Affinity_Meluna_EP03_007: Money doesn't matter. I already have enough of it.
Affinity_Meluna_EP04_001: What do you usually do in your spare time, Master?
Affinity_Meluna_EP04_002: I listen to music and read.
Affinity_Meluna_EP04_003:
Wow, that's so bland.
Even if those ARE your hobbies, you should say something more interesting.
Affinity_Meluna_EP04_004: I go to other homes to visit folks that need help.
Affinity_Meluna_EP04_005: Wh-What? How unexpected! I mean, not that I don't understand, though...
Affinity_Meluna_EP04_006: I'm so busy with work that I haven't thought about taking up a hobby yet...
Affinity_Meluna_EP04_007: That's a shame. Working can be a hobby, too, if you have a lot of money...
Affinity_Meluna_EP05_001: It's illegal to grow melons in Elias without my permission, so please be careful.
Affinity_Meluna_EP05_002: Haha, you've got to be kidding. What's next? There are melons that walk?!
Affinity_Meluna_EP05_003: ...Are you making fun of walking melons?
Affinity_Meluna_EP05_004: I didn't know that... I think I ate a few without permission.
Affinity_Meluna_EP05_005: Well, since you didn't know, I'll let it slide. Please be careful in the future. I'm glad you were honest with me.
Affinity_Meluna_EP05_007: Wh-What?! How do you know so much about melons?! Did you look them up somewhere?!
Affinity_Meluna_EP06_001: Where can I go to meet with the Head Priestess of the Order? Why is she so hard to find?
Affinity_Meluna_EP06_002: Look for the lazy Erpin, and you'll find her too.
Affinity_Meluna_EP06_003: Ah...! Use her as bait! That's a great idea.
Affinity_Meluna_EP06_004: Head Priestess? Ner? Why are you looking for Ner?
Affinity_Meluna_EP06_005:
She owes me some money that she hasn't paid back.
Ah... you're also in the Order! Maybe I could get you to pay for her instead?
Affinity_Meluna_EP06_006: Don't ask me. She scares me and I've been avoiding her.
Affinity_Meluna_EP06_007: Did you do something weird? I can't believe you're the Master and you don't know where the Head Priestess is... Wow.
Affinity_Meluna_EP07_001: How can you be so frugal, Master? It's admirable.
Affinity_Meluna_EP07_002: I'm frugal? Just this month I've spent...
Affinity_Meluna_EP07_003: Excuse me? That's all you've spent? See? I told you. You're frugal.
Affinity_Meluna_EP07_004: Just budget yourself appropriately and stick to that.
Affinity_Meluna_EP07_005: I see you still have a good sense of money. Good times.
Affinity_Meluna_EP07_006: I look frugal because I don't have any money. Please share if you have any to spare.
Affinity_Meluna_EP07_007: ...Are you serious? I don't have any cash on me... so I can't give you anything right now.
Affinity_Meluna_EP08_001: Why do elves launder money everywhere? I don't understand.
Affinity_Meluna_EP08_002: They launder money because it's dirty.
Affinity_Meluna_EP08_003: ...Oh... Umm... If that wasn't a figure of speech, I'll literally flip this table.
Affinity_Meluna_EP08_004: It's probably because of tax—Don't you pay taxes? When did you last pay your taxes?
Affinity_Meluna_EP08_005: Tax...? What's that? Erm... where can I find the forms to withdraw from the Order?
Affinity_Meluna_EP08_006: Well... elves are always up to things that are unexplainable.
Affinity_Meluna_EP08_007: They really are. It seems they're always creating headaches and hard times for themselves.
Affinity_Meluna_EP09_001: I've heard that illegally sourced melons are being delivered to the banquet hall.
Affinity_Meluna_EP09_002: We only buy them legally. Protect fair trade melons, right?
Affinity_Meluna_EP09_003: What? Fair trade? What's that? You aren't just saying gibberish to dodge the question, are you?
Affinity_Meluna_EP09_004: No way. I always pay my monthly subscription for melons.
Affinity_Meluna_EP09_005: Hmm, I must have been mistaken. Please continue to make timely payments.
Affinity_Meluna_EP09_006: What? You got proof or something? You'll need a warrant to search me for anything!
Affinity_Meluna_EP09_007: S-So fishy! You're being hostile for no reason. That makes you look even more suspicious!
Affinity_Meluna_EP10_001: Master, are you interested in seeking investors for the banquet hall?
Affinity_Meluna_EP10_002: You sure you'd want to invest? I doubt you'd make a profit or anything.
Affinity_Meluna_EP10_003: The operating costs of the banquet hall are mere pocket change, anyway. Uh, why are you glaring at me?
Affinity_Meluna_EP10_004: I'm not sure what you're up to, but I'll hear you out if you'll be straight with me.
Affinity_Meluna_EP10_005:
You're pretty sharp. The thing is, investing in religious organizations gives you tax breaks.
It's a win-win, right?
Affinity_Meluna_EP10_006: Why not invest in me instead of the banquet hall?
Affinity_Meluna_EP10_007: Hmm, I'm afraid your value plummeted the moment you said that. Please reevaluate yourself.
Affinity_Meluna_EP11_001: Everyone seems very interested in the secret behind how I amassed such vast wealth.
Affinity_Meluna_EP11_002: So what's the secret? Tell me and only me.
Affinity_Meluna_EP11_003: So you're one of them too. There's really no particular secret to it.
Affinity_Meluna_EP11_004: Might be a lot of trouble though?
Affinity_Meluna_EP11_005: Hmm... Are you more concerned about me than my wealth? That's quite unexpected.
Affinity_Meluna_EP11_006: How about doing an interview in a public place?
Affinity_Meluna_EP11_007: If I just say anything and leave, I'll probably get fewer questions in private settings.
Affinity_Meluna_EP12_001: I heard Festa is going to hold a special performance at the town square later. Are you going to watch the show too, Master?
Affinity_Meluna_EP12_003: I guess it's not to your taste. The world of music is vast and deep, so I'll respect your preferences.
Affinity_Meluna_EP12_004: Did you happen to invest in that performance?
Affinity_Meluna_EP12_005: Investment between friends? I just buy Festa food sometimes.
Affinity_Meluna_EP12_006: There are plenty of other performances, so why that one in particular...
Affinity_Meluna_EP12_007: Festa has a talent for stirring listeners' souls. Just thinking about it is exciting.
Affinity_Meluna_EP13_001: Isn't there a good place to practice singing?
Affinity_Meluna_EP13_002: You can practice as much as you want in the Banquet Hall.
Affinity_Meluna_EP13_003: Could you step outside for a moment, Master? I'll make sure the rental fee is worth your while.
Affinity_Meluna_EP13_004: How about going to the Elemental Forest?
Affinity_Meluna_EP13_005: I want to practice singing alone, but there are too many melons listening there.
Affinity_Meluna_EP13_006: Don't you have at least one spare room in your building?
Affinity_Meluna_EP13_007: All the soundproofed rooms are rented out... I wonder who I should evict...?
Affinity_Meluna_EP14_001: This melon bread from the convenience store... It makes me cry when I eat it. Master... would you like one too?
Affinity_Meluna_EP14_002: No, but I appreciate the thought.
Affinity_Meluna_EP14_003: Huh? I was offering you dessert, not my thoughts though?
Affinity_Meluna_EP14_004: How could I eat that when you are this sad?
Affinity_Meluna_EP14_005: What? My throat just got clogged up for a moment. Actually, this pastry doesn't contain any real melon.
Affinity_Meluna_EP14_006: Yeah. I was craving a snack, so this works out perfectly.
Affinity_Meluna_EP14_007: How is it? Does it taste good? I'm conducting a survey to see how it suits everyone else's tastes.
Affinity_Meluna_EP15_001: What are some things that money can't buy?
Affinity_Meluna_EP15_003: But you can buy those, can't you? There's even something called a "friend fee."
Affinity_Meluna_EP15_005: Heh... Master, just how much are you thinking of spending?
Affinity_Meluna_EP15_007: It's a cliché answer, but... you're right that "time" is something money definitely can't buy. I'll give you that.
Affinity_Meluna_EP16_001: Have you ever heard the sound of Musk walking?
Affinity_Meluna_EP16_002: I've heard the sound of you walking before.
Affinity_Meluna_EP16_003: I'm not Musk, you know. Is giving non-answers your specialty, Master?
Affinity_Meluna_EP16_005: Yes. It's just drowned out by other sounds so you can't hear it. Next time, focus and listen carefully.
Affinity_Meluna_EP16_007: I recommend coming to my garden sometime to listen. It's really... cute...
Affinity_Meluna_EP17_001: What's a good way to spend a holiday?
Affinity_Meluna_EP17_003: That's already part of my daily routine. Isn't there anything more fun?
Affinity_Meluna_EP17_005: Hmm, there's nothing quite as entertaining as looking at piles of money.
Affinity_Meluna_EP17_007: I already get plenty of sleep on a regular basis. Request denied.
Affinity_Meluna_EP18_001: Master, please say anything, and take your time. It would be great if you could use as many different words as possible.
Affinity_Meluna_EP18_003: Heh, thank you. Why did I ask you to speak, you wonder? That's a secret.
Affinity_Meluna_EP18_004: You are! Just a money-obsessed! Dummy!
Affinity_Meluna_EP18_005: I'm definitely being teased, but I have a feeling the Master is crying inside.
Affinity_Meluna_EP18_006: You... What are you planning to do with my voice!
Affinity_Meluna_EP18_007: You're quite perceptive. I was thinking of inputting the Master's voice into an AI for sound production...
Affinity_Meluna_EP19_001: Hmm, now that I look at it, the watering can seems a bit worn out.
Affinity_Meluna_EP19_002: It looks fine to me though?
Affinity_Meluna_EP19_003: There's a slight scratch on the handle. I should get a new one.
Affinity_Meluna_EP19_005: I can't water my melons with a watering can that might have been rolling around who knows where.
Affinity_Meluna_EP19_007: Considering the cost, time, and effort that would go into repairing it... buying a new one would be more efficient.
Affinity_Meluna_EP20_001: How should I persuade clients who won't budge even when offered amazing conditions?
Affinity_Meluna_EP20_002: You need to offer even better conditions.
Affinity_Meluna_EP20_003: If I offer even better conditions than this... hmm, they'd definitely have no choice but to come over.
Affinity_Meluna_EP20_005: You're saying I should appeal to our elemental nature to build rapport? Hmm, not a bad idea.
Affinity_Meluna_EP20_007: Master, I'm not that kind of malicious elemental. I'm different from a certain someone in the Sprite Kingdom.
